articles.summary: ICON schedules third quarter 2026 earnings conference call Iuliia.Krutikova Thu, 10/08/2026 - 06:46 ICON schedules third quarter 2026 earnings conference call Page tools Share Share Share on Linkedin Share on Bluesky Share on X Share on Facebook Dublin, Ireland, October 8, 2026 – ICON plc , (NASDAQ: ICLR) a world-leading clinical research organization, today announced that it will release its financial results for the third quarter 2026 after the market closes on Tuesday, October 27, 2026. The company will hold a conference call and webcast to discuss its financial results and performance on Wednesday, October 28, 2026 at 8:00am ET. Any changes to these events and links to the live webcasts (where available) will be posted on the Investor section of our website under “ Events ”. A webcast replay of the conference call will be available approximately one hour following the conclusion of the call. About ICON plc ICON plc is a world-leading clinical research organization. Offering deep operational and medical expertise we accelerate innovation, driving emerging therapies forward to improve patient outcomes. From molecule to medicine, we deliver integrated consulting, clinical development, commercialization and post-marketing solutions to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, government and public health organizations worldwide. With headquarters in Dublin, Ireland, ICON employed approximately 40,200 employees in 99 locations in 55 countries as at June 30, 2026. For further information about ICON, visit: www.iconplc.com .
